outline.title: TRIPSA — Saudi Route Intelligence
outline.summary: Title slide with the TRIPSA gold wordmark, the English slogan, and a one-line positioning statement for the TDF Hackathon.

outline.title: Saudi tourism is booming, but planning is still manual
outline.summary: 2025 official figures (29.3M inbound / SAR 176.6B, 93.3M domestic / SAR 127.1B) contrasted with fragmented, static, manual trip planning.

outline.title: No one owns the brain of the route
outline.summary: STA publishes static itineraries; Ministry tools serve businesses/investors. A validated gap for a traveler-facing route-intelligence engine.

outline.title: TRIPSA: an intelligent route engine for Saudi road trips
outline.summary: Optimized routes with stay dates, custom or certified-route modes, group room with invite code, and learning recommendations.

outline.title: Engineered for the traveler's real journey
outline.summary: Route optimizer, smart day scheduling around wake/sleep hours, real local restaurants matched to cuisine, interactive route map.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/upload/pasted_file_8Ru4oW_image.png - Screenshot of the TRIPSA working MVP app UI showing features like Optimized Routes, Create a trip, etc.

outline.title: Built for groups — a first in the market
outline.summary: Invite-code group room, voting, live consensus score, comments, For-You recommendations with ratings, email notifications.

outline.title: A clean, modular, data-driven pipeline
outline.summary: Data layer, engine layer (TSP, scheduler, consensus, recommender), Streamlit app layer, persistence, deployed on Streamlit Cloud.

outline.title: Two audiences, one platform
outline.summary: Tourist-facing simplicity plus a hidden admin dashboard (readiness, economic impact, demand/review analytics) for partners.

outline.title: Extends stays, spreads spend, empowers regions
outline.summary: Longer trips, wider geographic spend, local economic impact indicator, certified-route surfacing, actionable demand signals for TDF.

outline.title: A validated gap, a working product, a data moat
outline.summary: Live MVP, unique group-consensus planning, self-improving recommender, complements STA/Ministry, built on real 2025-2026 data.

outline.title: From hackathon MVP to national route-intelligence layer
outline.summary: Roadmap (live APIs, Arabic UI, PDF export, mobile) and the ask: pilot with TDF, official data access, growth-track incubation.
